title: UEFI firmware volume signature
summary: A UEFI firmware volume begins with the signature '_FVH' (0x5F 0x46 0x56 0x48) at offset 0. The firmware volume header contains: signature (4), filesystem GUID (16), length (8), signature (4), checksum (2), ext header offset (2), reserved (1), revision (1), block map (variable).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: UEFI firmware volumes contain PE/COFF executables, ACPI tables, and other firmware components.
UEFI supports Secure Boot, network boot, and GPT partitioning.
